basic_details.job_title: NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post, on contract basis, is open in the Electronics & Communication Engineering Department of the National Institute of Technology Calicut for the research project "Exploring Phase Gradient Metasurface for Anti Detection: A Study on Radar Signal Distortion", sponsored by LRDE - DRDO. The engagement is for 10 months (extendable based on performance and availability of fund) at a consolidated Rs. 37,000/- + 20% HRA per month. A first-class B.E./B.Tech. in ECE, EE or Engineering Physics with GATE is required. Applications go by email to [email protected] by 10 Dec

how_to_apply: Fill in the registration form annexed to the notice.
Prepare the most recent CV and soft copies of mark sheets/certificates in support of academic qualification and experience.
Consolidate the filled form, the CV and all soft copies into a single PDF document.
E-mail the PDF to [email protected], marked "Application for JRF", on or before 10 December 2026.
The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, documents and photograph submitted.
Soft copies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification/experience
No Objection Certificate from the employer, at the time of interview, for applicants already in employment (government or any other organization)

content_sections.heading: NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: National Institute of Technology Calicut (Office of Research and Consultancy)
Exploring Phase Gradient Metasurface for Anti Detection: A Study on Radar Signal Distortion
10 Months (extendable based on the performance and the availability of fund)
Electronics & Communication Engineering Department, NIT Calicut

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives two alternative routes to the essential qualification: Route 1: B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) / Electrical Engineering (EE) / Engineering Physics or equivalent with First Class and with a mandatory valid GATE score. Route 2: B.E./B.Tech. in ECE / EE / Engineering Physics or equivalent with First Class and M.E./M.Tech in a relevant discipline, with GATE qualified. A valid GATE score is not mandatory for post-graduates. Preference will be given to candidates having prior exposure or experience in one or more of these areas: Design and simulation of Electromagnetic Metasurfaces, Frequency Selective Surfaces (FSS), or Phased Array Antennas using CST Microwave Studio / HFSS. Strong analytical and programming skills in MATLAB/Python for radar signal processing (LFM waveforms, matched filtering, and Fourier optics/2D-DFT). Knowledge of Microwave Engineering, Wave Propagation, or Radar Cross Section (RCS) / Electronic Countermeasures. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience for candidates with exceptional credentials. The age limit is not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility wording, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Research Fellow receives a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 37,000/-, with 20% HRA per month in addition. The engagement is on contract basis for 10 months and is extendable based on the performance of the fellow and the availability of fund in the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Fill in the registration form annexed to the notice. Prepare the most recent CV and soft copies of mark sheets/certificates in support of academic qualification and experience. Consolidate the filled form, the CV and all soft copies into a single PDF document. E-mail the PDF to [email protected] , marked "Application for JRF", on or before 10 December 2026. The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, documents and photograph submitted. Duly filled registration form (as annexed) Most recent CV Soft copies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification/experience No Objection Certificate from the employer, at the time of interview, for applicants already in employment (government or any other organization)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted first. After shortlisting, eligible candidates will be notified by email and invited for the interview. The interview is held in hybrid mode (offline/online) and is scheduled for 14 December 2026. The notice does not mention the interview venue or reporting time; shortlisted candidates receive the details by email. Applicants already in employment must bring a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer to the interview along with the other documents. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the NIT Calicut JRF recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Junior Research Fellow position, in the Electronics & Communication Engineering Department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: A First Class B.E./B.Tech. in ECE / EE / Engineering Physics or equivalent with a mandatory valid GATE score, or the same degree with First Class plus M.E./M.Tech in a relevant discipline with GATE qualified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 37,000/- plus 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the JRF pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the pay as Rs. 37,000/- + 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: Fill the annexed registration form, combine it with your latest CV and certificates into one PDF, and email it to [email protected] marked "Application for JRF".

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NIT Calicut JRF?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted, and eligible candidates are notified by email and invited for a hybrid (offline/online) interview scheduled on 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is a valid GATE score mandatory for M.E./M.Tech holders?
faq.answer: No. A valid GATE score is not mandatory for post-graduates, but they must be GATE qualified.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NIT Calicut JRF a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is on contract basis for 10 months, extendable based on performance and the availability of fund.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
